decisive_items: An excisional biopsy of the lesion showed lobules and detached aggregates of eosinophilic keratinocytes with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli infiltrating the reticular dermis; there was no clear evidence of basaloid nests, and the diagnosis rendered was invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
response.rationale: The initial diagnosis was invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma based on the excisional biopsy results, and although new papular lesions were found to be basal cell carcinoma, the primary lesion was still the squamous cell carcinoma.

rejected.why: New papular lesions were found to be basal cell carcinoma, but the primary lesion was invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
